subject: SOC 2 timing + interim attestation to meet procurement cutoff — Stellaris AI
messages:
From: Kyle Barnes <kbarnes@stellaris.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: procurement@stellaris.ai
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 09:15:00 -0500
Subject: SOC 2 Type II timing and evidence for procurement review

Hi Logan / Marissa,

Thanks again for the product demo last week. Procurement has a hard deadline for vendor selection and they need our SOC 2 Type II report (or equivalent coverage) to complete legal approval. Their ask: a Type II report covering an audit period that includes the 12 months ending 2026-09-30. If the final Type II isn't available, they will accept a signed interim attestation / coverage letter plus a short evidence bundle (SIG or CAIQ exports + a handful of control artifacts) — but they need the docs by 2026-10-27 to stay on schedule.

Can you confirm:
- Do you have a Type II report that covers through 2026-09-30?
- If not, can you provide an interim attestation + control evidence within the next 7 days?

I've attached the procurement RFP for context (see attachment). Happy to jump on a quick call if helpful.

Thanks,
Kyle
Kyle Barnes
Senior Procurement Manager, Stellaris AI
procurement@stellaris.ai
Attachment: Stellaris_RFP.pdf
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Barnes <kbarnes@stellaris.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:02:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II timing and evidence for procurement review

Kyle — thanks for the clarity and the RFP.

Short answer: our SOC 2 Type II report for the period ending 2026-09-30 is currently in the final stages of the audit (report drafting), and we expect issuance in mid-November. That means we can't provide a finalized Type II report by 10/27, but we can provide an interim attestation/coverage letter plus a curated evidence packet (SIG/CAIQ exports, selected control artifacts, and a control matrix excerpt).

I'm looping in Rishi (security/compliance) and Irene (compliance ops) to confirm whether we can produce a signed interim attestation and the evidence bundle within the 7-day window. Marissa — keeping you in the loop so we align on commercial next steps with the prospect.

I'll update within 2 business hours with a proposed timeline.

Best,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 10:15:00 -05:00
Subject: ESCALATION: 7-day procurement cutoff — interim SOC 2 deliverables for Stellaris (DL-2026-1127)

Team — escalating a time-sensitive procurement ask. Details below. Procurement needs SOC 2 Type II coverage (audit period through 2026-09-30) or, alternately, an interim attestation + evidence bundle by 2026-10-27. This is a near-term revenue motion (expected ARR > $350k) and comes from a strategic buyer in our target vertical.

What I need from Security/Compliance (Rishi/Irene):
- Can we produce a signed interim attestation / coverage letter within 48 hours?
- Can we assemble a minimal evidence packet suitable for procurement: SIG/CAIQ exports, a short control matrix (mapping to common SOC 2 CCs), sample access logs (last 90 days), change-management records for production services, and recent pen-test summary?
- If the interim attestation is acceptable, what's the exact wording and scope we can commit to? Procurement will redact non-applicable items but needs authoritative language.

Constraints/notes:
- We are in final report drafting; official Type II issuance is currently estimated mid-November.
- Procurement is inflexible on the 10/27 deliverable.
- Marissa/Vivek: if security can commit to a 48–72h interim deliverable, we will route this as the gating artifact for legal/procurement and request an expedited procurement review.

Appreciate quick confirmation so I can update the buyer and lock in the demo follow-up.

Thanks,
Logan
From: Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>
To: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>
Date: Tue, 20 Oct 2026 12:30:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: ESCALATION: 7-day procurement cutoff — interim SOC 2 deliverables for Stellaris (DL-2026-1127)

Thanks for the heads up, Logan. We can support an interim attestation and a targeted evidence packet on an expedited timeline provided a couple of quick inputs from Compliance Ops. Proposed divide of work and timeline: 

What Security will deliver (within 48 hours):
- Signed interim attestation / coverage letter (template-based; we will include audit status and explicit audit period language).
- SIG Lite export and CAIQ snapshot (redacted for third-party details)
- Control matrix excerpt (CSV) mapping ~12 high-priority controls requested by procurement

What we need from Compliance Ops / Engineering (Irene):
- Export of access logs for the last 90 days for production service (to be included as sampling evidence) — ETA 24 hours.
- Change management evidence for the last 6 months (ticket URLs + summary) — ETA 24–36 hours.
- Recent pen-test summary PDF (if available) — ETA 24 hours.

Risks / language: the interim attestation will state that a SOC 2 Type II report is in progress and provide coverage up to 2026-09-30. It is not a substitute for a final furnished Type II report; we will include a target issuance estimate (mid-November) and standard caveats. Legal review can be light-touch for the interim letter, but we should copy Legal if there are any non-standard commitments.

Action owners assigned: Irene — evidence pulls; Marissa — coordinate commercial messaging + procurement contact; Logan/Vivek — external communications and escalation to prospect if needed. I'll draft the interim letter and attach a DocuSign-ready copy.

Rishi
Head of Security & Compliance
From: Logan Wright <logan_wright@redwood.ai>
To: Kyle Barnes <kbarnes@stellaris.ai>, procurement@stellaris.ai
Cc: Marissa Cole <marissa_cole@redwood.ai>, Rishi Malhotra <rishi_malhotra@redwood.ai>, Irene Choi <irene_choi@redwood.ai>
Date: Wed, 21 Oct 2026 15:40:00 -05:00
Subject: Re: SOC 2 Type II timing and evidence for procurement review

Kyle — thanks for your patience. Per our conversation and internal coordination, attached is an interim attestation that documents our SOC 2 Type II audit status and provides a scoped coverage statement for the audit period ending 2026-09-30. We have also included a targeted evidence bundle (SIG snapshot, CAIQ export, and a short control matrix excerpt).

Key points: 
- Our Type II audit is in final report drafting; estimated delivery of the finalized SOC 2 Type II is mid-November.
- The interim attestation has been signed by our Head of Security and indicates scope and the audit period requested.
- Evidence attached: SIG/CAIQ exports, control_matrix_excerpt.csv, and sample access log excerpts.

If procurement needs anything beyond the attached (for example, a notarized bridge letter or additional sample logs), please let me know immediately — we can escalate to Legal/Security for rapid handling. If it helps, I'm available for a 15-minute call today to walk procurement through the artifacts.

Thanks again — we want to make this as frictionless as possible to keep the timeline moving.

Best regards,
Logan Wright
Account Executive, Redwood Inference
Attachments: redwood_interim_attestation_stellaris_20261021.pdf, control_matrix_excerpt.csv
